title: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026
what_it_is: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026

sections.label: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure
sections.summary: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026 are in Paper Cmd 5 of 2026, with Heads of Expenditure taken en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026, contained in Paper Cmd 5 of 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: As there are no amendments, I propose to take the Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I will first take Heads E, L, P, S, V, W and Z of the Supplementary Main Estimates.
